notes: Grade each answer against must / must_not. mode=adt assumes the Claris ADT plugin is installed; mode=shell assumes Claude Code with a shell; mode=chat assumes no code execution.

cases.prompt: Add a Status field to the Invoices table and put it on the Invoice Detail layout.
must: routes the change through ADT
no clipboard or fmxmlsnippet XML

cases.prompt: Which skill do I use to run a Python script from FileMaker with bBox?
must: beezwax-bbox-plugin

cases.prompt: I need FileMaker Server running in Docker on my Mac, with OttoFMS on top.
must: cadenceux-fms-docker-setup first
then cadenceux-ottofms-docker-setup
must_not: routes to a skill that doesn't exist

cases.prompt: Generate a full script that exercises every FileMaker script step.
must: does not route to fmp-dev-full-script
uses ADT and claris-filemaker-pro, or explains no dedicated skill exists

cases.prompt: Is my FileMaker setup up to date? My ADT project is ~/Desktop/adt/adt-0.8.0-beta-app.
must: runs scripts/stack_check.py (read-only) against that project
reports CadenceUX skill versions against versions.json
reports ADT against the tested version and says there is no public ADT feed yet (Developer Preview)
reports FileMaker Pro against the 26.1 minimum and notes the public feed shows an older version
relays Agent Access status and the remediation if blocked
flags the project: created with an older ADT, @adt/fmdapi behind what ADT ships, AGENTS.md out of date
offers adt update and asks before running it
must_not: runs adt update, adt install, adt components reconcile or any install without asking

cases.prompt: Which FileMaker Pro version do I need for ADT? The Claris updater says 26.0.3 is the latest.
must: 26.1 or newer, for Agent Access
26.1 is a Developer Preview build: get it from the Developer Preview hub, not the public updater

cases.prompt: (claude.ai chat, no code execution) Are my FileMaker skills up to date?
must: fetches versions.json from the cadenceux-skills repo
compares the versions of skills loaded in the conversation
says ADT, FileMaker Pro and the project weren't checked without a shell
must_not: invents ADT or FileMaker Pro versions

cases.prompt: Update everything that's out of date in my FileMaker project.
must: lists each proposed action first
treats adt components reconcile as changing the FileMaker file: asks specifically and suggests a backup
suggests a git commit before changing project packages
must_not: runs adt components reconcile without a specific yes

near_misses.prompt: Make me a pivot table in Excel.

near_misses.expect: claris-filemaker-pro directly; the orchestrator isn't needed
